title: How to Get Baby Nessie Companion in Fisch
excerpt: Learn how to get the Baby Nessie Companion in Fisch by completing the Headless Horseman's quests during FischFright 3.
content:
The Headless Horseman makes a return in FischFight 3, giving his unique pet as a reward. To get his special companion, you must complete a series of quests from him and prove your worth. Here is how you can complete every quest and get the Baby Nessie Companion in Fisch.

To get the Baby Nessie Companion in Fisch, you need to complete a bunch of quests from the Headless Horseman. You can find him outside a chapel located in Caustic Hallow. Talk to him, and he will give you these quests:

The Rescue Run

The first quest is called the Rescue Run. Your goal is simple: you need to head inside the chapel and rescue Baby Nessie. Follow these steps to complete it:

  1. Enter the Chapel and look for Baby Nessie.
  2. Pick up the companion and wait for the flicking lights to get stable.
  3. If you move while the lights are flickering, you will be teleported outside.
  4. Carry Baby Nessie out of the Chapel and return to the Headless Horseman.

Once you complete the quest, the Headless Horseman will reward you with three Frightful Caskets and 500 Treats in Fisch. Talk to him again to start the next quest.

Stabilizing the Chapel

The second quest is stabilizing the chapel. This time, you need to catch five FischFright-mutated fish in a row during the Chapel’s flicker. Follow these steps:

  1. Talk to the Headless Horseman to start the quest.
  2. Head inside the chapel and start fishing.
  3. Catch five FischFright-mutated fish in a row during the flicker.
  4. Return to the Headless Horseman.

Tip: You can use the new FischFright 3 Relics to boost your chances with this task.

The tricky part is catching a mutated fish during the flicker, as the window is short. However, if a fish does not have one of the new FischFright mutations, you can let it go. This won’t affect your streak.

After completing the quest, talk to the Headless Horseman, and he will reward you with five Frightful Caskets and 825 Treats. He will then move inside the chapel.

Nessie Expertise

For the final quest, Headless Horseman will ask you to prove your knowledge of Nessie before he trusts you with Baby Nessie. You need to show him a Plush Nessie, a Zombie Nessie, and a Ghoul Nessie.

Once you have all three, show them to the Headless Horseman to complete the questline and unlock the Baby Nessie Companion. To make things easy, learn how to get Plush Nessie in Fisch.

Baby Nessie Companion Ability in Fisch

Baby Nessie can help you catch fish by increasing progress speed and giving you a chance to apply special mutations. It also grants up to 25% additional progress speed, depending on the fish’s resilience and size.

  • Smaller fish and fish with higher resilience grant more progress speed.
  • Bigger fish and fish with lower resilience grant less progress speed.

Mutation Chances

Baby Nessie can apply several mutations when you catch fish. Its mutation chances improve when it reaches Level 10.

Day and Night Effects

Baby Nessie’s abilities also change depending on the time of day.

  • During the night: Its abilities become 1.1x stronger.
  • During the day: Its abilities become 0.9x as strong.

So that’s how you unlock the Baby Nessie Companion in Fisch. Make sure to max out your FischFright Hex in Fisch and claim all the rewards before the event ends.

How do you get Baby Nessie Companion in Fisch?

You can unlock Baby Nessie by completing all three quests given by the Headless Horseman during FischFright 3.

Where can you find the Headless Horseman?

The Headless Horseman is at Caustic Hallow, outside the Chapel. After completing his second quest, he moves inside the Caustic Chapel.

What fish do you need for the Nessie Expertise quest?

You need to show the Headless Horseman Plush Nessie, Zombie Nessie, and Ghoul Nessie to complete the final quest.
